author: Seung Wook
problem: Given a non-empty list of non-negative integers, return the one whose digits read backwards make the largest number (leading zeros are dropped; on a tie keep the earliest).
bug_description: The reversed digits are compared as strings instead of integers, so for numbers of different lengths '9' beats '21'.

comments.accurate: Returns the number whose reversed digits give the largest integer value
comments.wrong_behavior: Returns the number whose reversed digits come last in string order
comments.wrong_location: Digit comparison verified; make sure the first number is not skipped
